items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 98:1
items.html: The spike of the hairs of Arich Anpin that reaches to its chest from behind it, where the head of ZA stands, which shines in it and brings out in its forehead the illumination of tefillin — it is called by the name Tzitz. And the spikes of the hairs of ZA, which shine in the head of the Nukva standing at its chest, and bring out in her forehead the aspect of tefillin, are called by the name Tzitzit. (Page 360, Item 139).
